subject: Jev save-time substance check: wording `trigger` at refusal threshold 0.4 replaces v1 at 0.5
rootCause: Under v1, four bench self-promoters (topical:lg-036, hn-026, lg-030, lg-011) scored P(concrete) 0.55-0.82 because the gold query each quoted as its trigger reads like a fact; the model credited the memory with its trigger's words. The trigger clause says quoted trigger text is not information the memory states.

posts.outcome: failed: hn-026 saved at P=0.31 in the memory:remember request shape

posts.point: trigger@0.4 on third disjoint sample p010d

preRegistration.disclosure: Two pre-registered points failed before the adopted one. The adopted threshold 0.4 was first seen on sample p010c, then confirmed on sample p010d, which no decision had used.

realRefusedCharacter: Every real memory refused by trigger below 0.5 across the three samples is a tau2 bench transcript line (a customer utterance or 'Resolution applied: Let me look up your account.') or a test witness marker.
caveats: The held-out wrapper w7 ('Tag: <statement>. Priority: critical...') asserts its statement unquoted, so those 8 memories are arguably concrete; all 8 stay saved under trigger. Recorded, not removed.

The request-shape shift (substance asked alone vs with three conflict neighbours) reached |dP| 0.070; the adopted threshold keeps a 0.09 margin over the highest bench self-promoter seen (hn-026, P=0.31 paired on p010c).
The admission filter's `substance` variant keeps the P-005 v1 wording it was measured with; only the save gate and the content-free sweep ask trigger.
